name: single_step_right_setting
title: A：单步“点击右边的设置按钮”
description: One-step spatial click through the real StepFun voice session. The controlled page has two same-named 设置 buttons; the runner requires the right-hand one to be clicked exactly once, through a click contract with region=right (never an open_app, never a right_click, never the left-hand twin).
